newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Firmer Swiss money rates normal fluctuation - Rich.
newsitem.headline: Firmer Swiss money rates normal fluctuation - Rich.

text.p: A recent firming of Swiss money market rates was the result of fluctuations in the market and not a result of central bank policy aimed at maintaining a specific interest rate level, Swiss National Bank chief economist Georg Rich said.

"We don't have a policy of trying to maintain a certain interest rate level. We allow significant fluctuations of interest rates. Sometimes the rates are lower, sometimes higher but these are coincidental fluctuations in the money market," Rich said in response to an enquiry.
"The intention is not to have interest rates rise," he added.
